title: Linear and asymmetric interactions of bank and stock market development under monetary policy uncertainty in Nigeria
core_idea: Investigate the functional interaction between bank development and stock market development in Nigeria under monetary policy uncertainty using monthly data (1990:m1–2022:m4) and linear and nonlinear autoregressive distributed lag models, with key variables (CPS, M2, MCAP, IP) scaled by GDP and a logged measure of policy uncertainty.
tldr: This study examines how monetary policy uncertainty relates to the interplay between bank and stock market development in Nigeria, applying linear and nonlinear ARDL methods to monthly GDP-scaled financial and activity indicators from 1990 to 2022.
